title: Bootstrap EKS provisioner Terraform module for Redwood Private control plane
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that provisions the Redwood Private control plane on AWS EKS inside a customer VPC. The module should support VPC integration (existing or created), private endpoint configuration, IAM roles for the control plane components, nodegroup definitions for control-plane-adjacent services, and outputs required by the Private installer. It must be opinionated enough to reduce footguns but flexible for enterprise networking constraints (cross-account subnets, custom CNI, flow logs).
acceptance_criteria: Module can create an EKS cluster and control-plane support resources given either an existing VPC or VPC creation flags
Module produces stable outputs (cluster_name, cluster_endpoint, cluster_oidc_issuer, kubeconfig_cert_data) consumable by the Private installer
Module documents required input variables and common network patterns (private subnets, NAT gateway options, cross-account routing)
Automated terraform plan/apply runs in CI for a smoke environment succeed and cluster reaches ACTIVE state
Health checks (control-plane API responsiveness, kube-system critical pods running) are executable via terraform null_resource scripts and documented in the runbook
Module supports a safe in-place upgrade path for nodegroups and control-plane minor versions with minimal drift (documented upgrade steps)
Security review completed and KMS/HSM integration pattern documented for secrets and kubeconfig generation
implementation_notes: Start with a thin module that wires: VPC (optional creation), EKS cluster resource (eksctl or community aws_eks_cluster), nodegroups (managed), OIDC provider and IRSA roles
Prefer community-maintained terraform provider patterns (terraform-aws-modules/eks/aws) to reduce maintenance, but wrap with opinionated inputs/outputs
Expose a variable for controlPlaneCIDR / apiServerEndpointAccess (private | public | both) to support customer firewall requirements
Include optional integration to enable AWS PrivateLink endpoints for S3, ECR if provided in inputs
Add null_resource based healthcheck scripts that run kubectl (via generated kubeconfig) after creation to validate core namespace pods
Keep sensitive outputs minimal; recommend storing kubeconfigs in KMS-encrypted S3 instead of as plaintext outputs
Write examples/ folder with: minimal create VPC+EKS, join to existing VPC, cross-account subnet example, and upgrade playbook example
